That job generated adjustment entries that show up as a backcharge on this invoice.

To help procurement review, can you confirm the TXN id you see on the invoice (TXN-20260701-9F) — if that matches what you have, Ben (cc) will pull the per-request mapping and a short CSV export showing the affected request_ids and token counts. If it doesn't match, please paste the invoice line here.

Ben: can you pull the reattribution job details and a compact sample export for Wintercrest (request_id, timestamp, original_tag, new_tag, token_count)? If we can produce a short per-request extract and the ledger reference we'll be able to close this quickly.

I'll hold on the formal credit until we have Ben's export and confirm legal/procurement alignment, but from a product perspective this appears to be a legitimate retro attribution rather than a metering bug.
